optimization_reports.summary:
## Surgical Partial Revert of Iter-01 mcp-mat-sg SKILL.md

**Root cause**: The iter-01 optimization added ~30 lines of **mandatory verification steps** (Post-build verification, Geometry verification, prescriptive passivation rewrite, MANDATORY chemical grounding) that inflated token usage and turn counts, pushing 4 previously-completing tasks into timeout territory and degrading quality on 6 more.

**Evidence** (iter_01 → iter_02 comparison):
| Task | iter_01 (before) | iter_02 (after) | Root cause |
|---|---|---|---|
| BP_struct_004 | 9 turns, 249s ✓ | **TIMEOUT 1200s** | Mandatory verification on each batch item |
| SC_struct_SiH | 7 turns, 219s ✓ | **TIMEOUT 1200s** | Prescriptive passivation rewrite |
| SC_struct_006 | 29 turns, 784s ✓ | **TIMEOUT 1200s** | Verification overhead pushed past limit |
| CR_SC_ZnPd011 | 9 turns, 93K tok | 33 turns, **594K tok** | Mandatory verification loops (6.4× tokens) |
| SC_struct_005 | 10 turns, 274K tok | 15 turns, **552K tok** | MANDATORY grounding doubled tokens |
| CR_SC_ZnS001 | 5 turns, 69K tok | 11 turns, **456K tok** | Rigid layer-count + verification cascade |

**Changes made** (net +7 lines vs iter_01 baseline, down from +31):
1. **Removed**: Post-build verification (mandatory), Geometry verification section, Molecular crystal slabs bullet, prescriptive passivation rewrite, rigid Layer count compliance, MANDATORY chemical grounding
2. **Reverted**: passivation section → original concise form
3. **Retained** (light, additive only):
   - Soft "Layer count" 1-line hint
   - Soft chemical/physical grounding suggestion (1 line)
   - CO2RR tips section (3 concise lines) — likely drove CR_SC_ZnO_Au_HCOO +44pt gain

**Expected outcome**: Recover the 10 regressed tasks (especially the 4 that timed out) while preserving the CO2RR workflow gain.
